# Poe2RitualReward

[API index](../index.md)

One reward from the current Ritual offer table. Scalar offer facts are copied while the coherent
window snapshot is borrowed; the item entity remains native and resolves only when Item is read.

## InventoryKey

```typescript
InventoryKey: number;
```

## Element

```typescript
Element: Element;
```

## NormalCost

```typescript
NormalCost: number | null;
```

Missing offers and the native `0xFFFF` sentinel are null, never zero-cost rewards.

## Item

```typescript
Item: Entity | null;
```

The existing native Entity accessor graph. Component metadata is not decoded until its own
members are requested. Null means no current item or an unavailable reward observation.
